svg.title: How I evolved
svg.desc: Latest first: 2024-now AI Solutions Engineer at DevRev (generative and agentic AI, L4, M3-M4; airline payments desk 15-30 to under 5 min per case, target), then 2021-2024 Presales Manager to Lead Solutions Consulting at MoEngage (predictive ML, L2; +50% conversion to proposal). A dotted line points ahead to Solutions Architect, governed enterprise AI.
svg.text: The model is a component; the solution is the product.
AI is only as good as the event data feeding it.
